text:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up: drafting a canary rollout schema for model v2. Idea: per-step hold windows + evaluation hooks that can auto-pause or step-back. Putting a short sketch here, looking for comments on cohort hashing, percent math, and guard triggers.

cheng (eng-runtime): Love the hooks. Quick q: how are cohorts computed? header override? user_id hash? Also are step durations fixed or adaptive?

maria (eng-platform): Plan is deterministic hashing on route key (default user_id). Optional header override for partner testing. Steps are minutes by default, with an optional "slo_stable" heuristic: if latency/error metrics degrade above threshold, extend hold and run extra evals.

sam (product): Product asks for mandatory manual override UI in Console w/ required audit note and RBAC check. Also we need per-tenant exposure caps so a single big customer doesn't skew signals.

ivy (eng-sre): Strong +1 on caps. Also add an ingress backpressure breaker: if queue growth > 30% or p99 latency > 2s -> immediate pause + trigger rollback policy. We can wire into the existing circuit-breaker service.

cheng (eng-runtime): Implementation note: geometric warmup (0.5%, 1.5%, 4.5%, 13.5%) surfaces faults faster than linear. Downside: more complex math in Console. Upside: shorter time-to-signal. Thoughts?

maria (eng-platform): Good call. How about hybrid: tiny geometric warmup for first 3 steps, then switch to linear steps. Example config below.

maria (eng-platform): ```json
{
  "canary_id": "canary-v2-2026-04-12-37",
  "route": "/api/generate",
  "cohort_key": "user_id",
  "cohort_override_header": "X-Canary-Cohort",
  "max_exposure_per_account_pct": 5,
  "steps": [
    {"pct": 0.5, "duration_min": 30, "eval_hooks": ["perf","smoke_prompts"], "hold_on_fail": true},
    {"pct": 1.5, "duration_min": 30, "eval_hooks": ["perf","smoke_prompts"], "hold_on_fail": true},
    {"pct": 4.5, "duration_min": 60, "eval_hooks": ["perf","quality_eval"], "hold_on_fail": true},
    {"pct": 10,  "duration_min": 120, "eval_hooks": ["perf","quality_eval"], "hold_on_fail": false}
  ],
  "backpressure_rules": {"queue_growth_pct": 30, "p99_latency_ms": 2000},
  "rollback_on_quality_drop_pct": 5,
  "require_n_consecutive_passes": 2
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary config saved by maria. ID: canary-v2-2026-04-12-37

sam (product): Telemetry hooks must include: latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token-rate, plus qualitative evals from the eval harness (sampled prompts). Alerts to console + slack + oncall email.

cheng (eng-runtime): Propose eval API: POST /internal/evals/run -> returns {pass:bool, scores:{}, detail_url}. We'll persist last N runs and gate steps on N consecutive passes. Also suggest short-circuit for catastrophic failures (e.g., safety filter spikes).

ivy (eng-sre): Add automated rollback action if quality drops > 5% or user-facing errors > 0.5%. Also add a cooldown window after rollback to avoid flip-flopping. Alert paging to oncall and create incident stub automatically.

maria (eng-platform): :thumbsup: I'll refine the schema + add UI mocks for Console: per-step "Hold" / "Step back" / "Force proceed (RBAC)" buttons and an audit note modal. Will open PR with tests and link to eval harness.

cheng (eng-runtime): One more: enforce "max_exposure_per_account_pct" in the router so a single tenant never gets >X% of canary traffic even if hashed. We can do this with a per-tenant token bucket check.

maria (eng-platform): Agreed. I'll add "max_exposure_per_account_pct" to the schema and include a short runbook for oncall. Tagging you all on the PR shortly.
